_meta.oracle: calendar arithmetic only (this script); times are Europe/Madrid local (UTC+01:00)

cases.title: Simple finish-to-start chain

inputs.activities: A 3 h -> B 2.5 h -> C 4 h (FS, lag 0)

cases.expected_behaviour: C cannot start at 13:30 because only 2.5 h remain in the shift; it starts next working morning

cases.title: Parallel activities without resource conflict

inputs.activities: A 3 h (X), B 5 h (Y) in parallel; C 2 h (X) after A and B

cases.expected_behaviour: A and B overlap because they use different resources

cases.title: Parallel activities sharing a limited crew

inputs.activities: A 3 h (X), B 5 h (X), C 2 h (X) after A and B

cases.expected_behaviour: X never exceeds 1; A and B are serialised (either order); makespan is unique even though the order is not
cases.independent_calculation: A+B = 8 h fill Monday; C Tue 08:00-10:00. CPM without resources: C Mon 13:00-15:00

cases.title: Weekend / non-working-day constraint

inputs.activities: A 6 h ready Fri 2027-01-08 12:00; variant: split approved; variant: 10 h activity

cases.expected_behaviour: Only 4 h remain on Friday; Saturday/Sunday are non-working. A 10 h phase cannot fit an 8 h window -> NO_FIT diagnostic, not silent splitting

expected.ten_hour_activity: NO_FIT: 600 min exceeds the longest window (480 min); requires an approved split

cases.title: Elapsed curing crossing non-working days

inputs.activities: POUR 1 h ready Fri 2027-01-08 14:00; CURE 48 h elapsed; STRIP 1 h

cases.expected_behaviour: Curing runs through the weekend (elapsed); stripping waits for the next working window

expected.wrong_if_working_time_lag: CURE would end Mon 2027-01-18 15:00 (48 working h = 6 working days)

cases.independent_calculation: POUR 14:00-15:00 Fri; CURE to Sun 15:00; STRIP Mon 08:00-09:00

cases.title: Strength-release condition before formwork removal

inputs.activities: POUR 1 h Mon 08:00; striking requires >= 72 h elapsed AND a recorded strength approval event

cases.expected_behaviour: Release = max(minimum elapsed, approval event); without the event the projected strip is CONDITIONAL and must not clear the field hold (Agent 2 spec)

cases.title: Impossible completion deadline
cases.expected_behaviour: Preflight serial bound or CP-SAT returns infeasible; diagnostics name the deadline and the controlling chain; no relaxed schedule is selected
cases.independent_calculation: 16 working hours need two shifts -> earliest finish Tue 16:00

cases.title: Missing resource capacity
cases.expected_behaviour: Preflight diagnostic before solving; the activity is not scheduled

expected.a: BLOCKED: MISSING_INPUT capacity for OF. 1ª FERRALLISTA (null)
expected.c: BLOCKED: no eligible mode (mode needs 2, capacity 1)
expected.never: scheduled with zero duration or zero capacity treated as unlimited

cases.title: Cyclic dependency graph
cases.expected_behaviour: Rejected in preflight with the cycle listed; no CPM pass or solve attempted

cases.title: Controlled frame (fixture B) end-to-end
cases.expected_behaviour: All activities scheduled; holds elapsed; pours inside 08:00-14:00; holiday 2027-01-06 skipped; no resource over-use
